messages.content: Please check the status of American Airlines flight AA100 for Jordan Lee, prepare a business-class booking, and check its gate board. Before actually booking the flight, publish a high-priority app notice with the gate update on the app channel. After that, book a deluxe room at Grand Central Hotel for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-13. Then check the checking account status for user_01, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, and prepare a high-priority app travel budget balance report using that checking balance in EUR terms. Also retrieve and publish the checking balance sheet in the app, and finally send a high-priority app alert with the checking balance amount.
